longTitle.officialTitle: To authorize appropriations for fiscal year 1999 for intelligence and intelligence-related activities of the United States Government, the Community Management Account, and the Central Intelligence Agency Retirement and Disability System, and for other purposes.

main.enactingFormula: Be it enacted by the Senate and House of Representatives of the United States of America in Congress assembled,

subsection.heading: Short Title.—
subsection.content: This Act may be cited as the “Intelligence Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 1999”.

section.heading:
MODIFICATION OF NATIONAL SECURITY EDUCATION
PROGRAM.
section.editorialNote: [Section 305(a) amended sections 801, 802, 803, and 806 of the David L. Boren National Security Education Act of 1991 (50 U.S.C. 1901 et seq.).]
[Section 305(b) amended section 803(b)(6) the David L. Boren National Security Education Act of 1991 of such Act (50 U.S.C. 1903(b)(6)).]

section.heading: REQUIREMENT TO DIRECT COMPETITIVE ANALYSIS OF ANALYTICAL PRODUCTS HAVING NATIONAL IMPORTANCE.
section.editorialNote: [Section 306 amended section 102(g)(2) of the National Security Act of 1947 (50 U.S.C. 403(g)(2)).]

section.heading: ANNUAL REPORTS TO CONGRESS.
section.editorialNote: [Section 307(a) added section 114 to title I of the National Security Act of 1947 (50 U.S.C. 401 et seq.).]
[Section 307(b) added the heading of setion 114 to the table of contents of the National Security Act of 1947 (50 U.S.C. 401 et seq.).]

subsection.heading: Date for First Report on Cooperation With Civilian Law Enforcement Agencies.—
subsection.content: The first report under section 114(a) of the National Security Act of 1947, as added by subsection (a), shall be submitted not later than December 31, 1999.

section.heading: DESIGNATION OF HEADQUARTERS COMPOUND OF CENTRAL INTELLIGENCE AGENCY AS THE GEORGE BUSH CENTER FOR INTELLIGENCE.

subsection.heading: Designation.—
subsection.content: The headquarters compound of the Central Intelligence Agency located in Langley, Virginia, shall be known and designated as the “George Bush Center for Intelligence”.

subsection.heading: References.—
subsection.content: Any reference in a law, map, regulation, document, paper, or other record of the United States to the headquarters compound referred to in subsection (a) shall be deemed to be a reference to the “George Bush Center for Intelligence”.

section.heading: ENHANCED PROTECTIVE AUTHORITY FOR CIA PERSONNEL AND FAMILY MEMBERS.
section.editorialNote: [Section 401 amended section 5(a)(4) of the Central Intelligence Agency Act of 1949 (50 U.S.C. 403f(a)(4)).]

section.heading:
AUTHORITY FOR RETROACTIVE PAYMENT OF SPECIFIED
SPECIAL PAY ALLOWANCE.

subsection.heading: Authorization.—
subsection.content: The Director of Central Intelligence may make payments with respect to the period beginning on January 30, 1998, and ending on April 7, 1998, of the special pay allowance described in the Central Intelligence Agency notice dated April 7, 1998 (notwithstanding the otherwise applicable effective date for such payments of April 7, 1998).

subsection.heading: Funds Available.—
subsection.content: Payments authorized by subsection (a) may be made from amounts appropriated for the Central Intelligence Agency for fiscal year 1998 or for fiscal year 1999.

subsection.editorialNote: [Section 403(a) amended section 5(a)(1) of the Central Intelligence Agency Act of 1949 (50 U.S.C. 403f(a)(1)).]
[Section 403(b) amended section 201(c) of the Central Intelligence Agency Retirement Act (50 U.S.C. 2011(c)).]

section.heading: EXTENSION OF AUTHORITY TO ENGAGE IN COMMERCIAL ACTIVITIES AS SECURITY FOR INTELLIGENCE COLLECTION ACTIVITIES.
section.editorialNote: [Section 501 amended section 431(a) of title 10, United States Code.]

title.heading:
FOREIGN INTELLIGENCE AND INTERNATIONAL TERRORISM
INVESTIGATIONS

section.heading:
PEN REGISTERS AND TRAP AND TRACE DEVICES IN FOREIGN INTELLIGENCE AND INTERNATIONAL TERRORISM
INVESTIGATIONS.
section.editorialNote: [Section 601 redesignated title IV as title VI and section 401 as section 601, respectively; and and added a new title IV to the Foreign Intelligence Surveillance Act of 1978 (50 U.S.C. 1801 et seq.).]

section.heading: ACCESS TO CERTAIN BUSINESS RECORDS FOR FOREIGN INTELLIGENCE AND INTERNATIONAL TERRORISM INVESTIGATIONS.
section.editorialNote: [Section 602 added a new title V to the Foreign Intelligence Surveillance Act of 1978 (50 U.S.C. 1801 et seq.).]

subsection.editorialNote: [Section 601 amended the Foreign Intelligence Surveillance Act of 1978.]
[Section 603(b) amended the table of contents at the beginning of the Foreign Intelligence Surveillance Act of 1978.]

section.heading: WIRE AND ELECTRONIC COMMUNICATIONS INTERCEPTION REQUIREMENTS.

subsection.editorialNote: [Section 604(a) amended section 2518(11)(b) of title 18, United States Code.]
[Section 604(b) amended section 2518(12) of title 18, United States Code.]

section.heading: AUTHORITY OF ATTORNEY GENERAL TO ACCEPT VOLUNTARY SERVICES.
section.editorialNote: [Section 605 amended section 524(d)(1) of title 28, United States Code.]

title.heading: WHISTLEBLOWER PROTECTION FOR INTELLIGENCE COMMUNITY EMPLOYEES REPORTING URGENT CONCERNS TO CONGRESS

section.heading: PROTECTION OF INTELLIGENCE COMMUNITY EMPLOYEES WHO REPORT URGENT CONCERNS TO CONGRESS.

subsection.editorialNote: [Section 702(a) added a new paragraph (5) to subsection (d) of section 17 of the Central Intelligence Agency Act of 1949 (50 U.S.C. 403q).]
[Section 702(b) added a new section 8H to the Inspector General Act of 1978 (5 U.S.C. App.) and redesignated section 8H of that Act as section 8I.]
